data.other_hard: first-time enrolment in France; under 30 years of age during the year of application; not receiving other funding above 600 euros per month; not cumulated with France Excellence Eiffel, France Excellence Europa or Erasmus Mundus scholarships; admission to a master's programme operated by listed Paris-Saclay institutions
data.evidence_sentence: Students of foreign nationality meeting the following cumulative criteria are eligible to apply: - Admission in a master's degree of Université Paris-Saclay operated by one of the following institutions: AgroParisTech, CentraleSupélec, ENS Paris-Saclay, INSTN-CEA, IOGS, Université Évry Paris-Saclay, Université Paris-Saclay, UVSQ - First-time enrolment in France (students who have never been registered in a French Higher Education Institution – except exchange programs, Erasmus Mundus joint master's degrees without a French degree, internships and language programs) - Under 30 years of age during the year of application Students who are receiving any other funding above 600 euros per month will be declared ineligible.
data.notes: Benefit is 10 000 euros per year paid monthly plus a travel/visa flat fee of up to 900 euros; funding is a fixed amount so classified as partial. Deadline on page is for 2026 (25 March candidate selection by coordinators, 31 March scholarship application deadline); the 2026 date has passed as of 2026-11-21 so recorded as annual:03-31. Applicants must be admitted to the master's before the set deadline; the scholarship renews for a second year (M2) for laureates, which is not an entry requirement. Refugee/subsidiary protection status gives a bonus, not a requirement; selection by jury criteria includes academic background, personal project and PhD motivation (M2 candidates). Page says the program is particularly aimed at, but not limited to, those wishing to pursue a PhD. No minimum GPA stated.
